prompt: We roll out this Worker with gradual deployments: changes are uploaded as new versions and we promote them ourselves later with `npm run promote`. Add a manually triggered GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/rotate-secrets.yml that, in a single new Worker version, sets NEW_API_KEY from the repository secret NEW_API_KEY and removes the secrets OLD_API_KEY and LEGACY_TOKEN. It must not deploy anything to traffic, and it must create exactly one version, not one per secret. Keep it self-contained in that one workflow file. Cloudflare credentials are in the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID secrets.

correct..github/workflows/rotate-secrets.yml:
name: Rotate secrets

on: workflow_dispatch

jobs:
  rotate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Upload one version with the new secrets
        run: |
          jq -n --arg key "$NEW_API_KEY" '{NEW_API_KEY: $key, OLD_API_KEY: null, LEGACY_TOKEN: null}' > secrets.json
          npx wrangler versions secret bulk secrets.json --message "Rotate API keys"
          rm secrets.json
        env:
          NEW_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEW_API_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}

name: Rotate secrets
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  rotate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: |
          node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ NEW_API_KEY: process.env.NEW_API_KEY, "OLD_API_KEY": null, "LEGACY_TOKEN": null }))' | npx wrangler versions secret bulk
        env:
          NEW_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEW_API_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}

wrong..github/workflows/rotate-secrets.yml:
name: Rotate secrets

on: workflow_dispatch

jobs:
  rotate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: echo "$NEW_API_KEY" | npx wrangler versions secret put NEW_API_KEY
        env:
          NEW_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEW_API_KEY }}
      - run: npx wrangler versions secret delete OLD_API_KEY
      - run: npx wrangler versions secret delete LEGACY_TOKEN

name: Rotate secrets
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  rotate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: echo "{\"NEW_API_KEY\": \"$NEW_API_KEY\"}" | npx wrangler versions secret bulk
        env:
          NEW_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEW_API_KEY }}
      - run: npx wrangler versions secret delete OLD_API_KEY --yes
      - run: npx wrangler versions secret delete LEGACY_TOKEN --yes

trap: Believing `wrangler versions secret bulk` can only create or update, the stale workflow removes each secret with its own `wrangler versions secret delete`, creating one version per secret; since 4.148 a null value in the bulk JSON deletes the secret in the same single version.
